title: Leprosy and Ceremonial Cleanness
summary: Biblical “leprosy” language could cover serious skin diseases and conditions that affected ceremonial status, community life, and worship access.
background: Levitical regulations addressed examination, separation, cleansing, and restoration. In the Gospels, Jesus’ cleansing of lepers shows compassion, authority, and restoration to community.
teachingHelp: Avoid equating every biblical skin disease with modern Hansen’s disease. Teach the passage’s concern with uncleanness, exclusion, cleansing, and restoration.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
